week.title: FX Daily: Dollar buying returns ahead of FOMC
week.desc: The greenback has had a good start to the week – in our view, thanks to AI-sentiment stabilisation and some positioning ahead of tomorrow’s FOMC announcement. Today, the focus will be on US consumer confidence, as well as Israeli elections and their potential impact on the Middle East equilibrium. In New Zealand, we expect a hawkish 25bp hike overnight

week.title: October ECB cheat sheet: French malaise shouldn’t prompt a dovish turn
week.desc: Markets will scan the European Central Bank announcement on 29 October for any signs that French bond turmoil has triggered a dovish rethink. We don’t think it has, and expect the ECB to leave the door open for a December hike, which should shield rates and the euro from a major adjustment. As usual, we also look at three alternative scenarios to our baseline

week.title: FX Daily: Abatement in AI risk helps the dollar
week.desc: Fears of an AI bust have receded slightly, and the AI story has been helped overnight by impressive 3Q results from Korean chipmaker SK Hynix. This has allowed the market to focus on the core story of resilient growth, high inflation and the prospect of higher energy prices – all dollar-positive. Look out for the Fed, the Bank of Canada and the UK budget today
